name: Pike push-up
instructions: Start in a downward-dog position, hips high, hands on the floor.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Push back up through your hands to the start.
cue: Hips high, head to the floor
mistakes: Letting the hips drop toward push-up form.
